status_summary: No public record was found of OMB splitting its six Resource Management Offices or creating additional PAD and Deputy PAD positions since 2025-01-20. OMB's apportionment delegation notices (effective 2025-02-11 and 2025-04-18) refer to the existing Program Associate Director and Deputy Associate Director structure without describing new offices.

timeline.event: OMB delegated apportionment authority to its Program Associate Directors; the notice names no new or split offices.
A second OMB delegation notice took effect, setting a succession order through Deputy Associate Directors, Branch Chiefs and other PADs of the existing structure; it names no new or split offices.

title: Divide OMB's six resource management offices into smaller areas with more political PADs
uncertainties: The whitehouse.gov OMB pages fetched did not list leadership or offices, and the OMB leadership page could not be fetched. News searches returned no reporting on a split of the resource management offices or new deputy PAD roles. Absence of public evidence is not proof that no internal reorganization or hiring occurred. A reviewer rerun on 2026-10-10 of a Federal Register API query for Program Associate Director since 2025-01-20 returned only the April 2025 OMB notice and an unrelated OPM notice, and one web search found no report of a reorganization. Whether the April notice replaced the February one is not stated in it.
